text: Sqlpipe moves data from Postgres to S3 in three stages: reading, conversion, and upload. A reader process streams rows from Postgres in batches. The reader sends each batch to a converter. The converter turns each batch into a Parquet row group. The converter passes each row group to an uploader. The uploader writes the row groups to S3 as multipart objects. If an upload fails, the uploader retries the request. The three stages run as separate processes. Each process passes data to the next process in the pipeline. This separation limits memory use because each stage holds only one batch at a time. If another stage is slow, one stage can still run at full speed.
